summary: NDR feed c085_broker_link is severely degraded by packet loss: BROKER-A port 1/5 is discarding 56.32% of packets due to 10 Gbps egress saturation plus an additional 3.66% loss on the link to NDR eth1. NDR is missing >50% of traffic.

findings.root_cause: BROKER-A port 1/5 (to NDR) is oversubscribed: average load 100% of 10 Gbps with bursts higher, causing the packet broker to discard 96,697,500 packets on output (56.32% loss). Additionally, 75,000,000 packets sent by the broker but only 72,253,200 seen on NDR eth1 indicates ~3.66% loss on the physical path between them (cable/optic/patch).
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires complete bidirectional traffic with full payload; missing >56% of packets breaks flow reassembly, state tracking and detection. Majority of sessions invisible, alerts and forensic coverage severely degraded.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute the >10 Gbps aggregate across 2+ 10G tool ports (or upgrade to 25/40/100G) to eliminate egress queue drops, and simultaneously check/replace optics/cabling on BROKER-A 1/5 to NDR eth1 to fix the additional 3.66% link loss. If capacity cannot be added immediately, apply selective filtering to reduce load below 10 Gbps.
